theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ir_inertia_cardinality
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (q : ℕ), q.Prime → ∀ P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), P.IsPrime → P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → Nat.card (P.inertia (E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E)) = Ideal.ramificationIdx P ℤ
